status: Guarded artifacts assessed and structurally qualified; manual assistive-technology review remains separate
method: Inline stylesheet insertion plus forced synchronous layout; alternating precompiled/Graph Paper order. Compare initial, resized, alternate-layout and added-source geometry for every composition, detect same-region overlap, and omit invalid-operation timings. Fixed CSS knows both layouts and source totals; it does not provide automatic allocation, metadata, feature fallback or captured ruler-length semantics. Timings exclude network, paint, images, GPU, scrolling and real-device interaction; not an interaction budget. Chromium style/layout totals also include preflight and warmups.
schema: Operation arrays are [median,p95] milliseconds. Absent invalidStates means all four geometry phases passed. Null operation timings are omitted invalid work, not zero cost. Source changes append/remove one item per composition; all roots change together.
